retention_semantics: Successful rotation retains at most 256 JSON receipts; interrupted commit/rotation may retain 257. Subsequent writers reconcile excess before appending, so persistent delete failures do not grow storage. Old records are not removed until replacement file and directory are fsynced. Failed temp cleanup always closes writer lock.

gap_recommendation.reason: Future failure evidence is durably recorded on local POSIX volume, but historical incident cause cannot be reconstructed. Production mount persistence and live failure diagnosis remain unmeasured.

limitations: No full preflight or generators run (root owns serialized shared-log workflow)
No commit, push, PR, or deployment by this agent
Privacy boundary is operator-only filesystem receipts; bbox is sensitive and hashes are not anonymization
Final publish must re-evaluate GATE-01 and actual deploy mapping; root owns authorization
